title: 第五章 变态啊第六章 你们才不知廉耻
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
唐斩月摸了摸怀里还在沉睡的小狗，“看见那边的悬浮车了吗？等你能动了，开车送我回家。”
叶峥看了眼她怀里的赤璃，神色有些奇怪。
等了几秒后，他诧异开口：“就这样？”
“就这样。”唐斩月想了想，又道：“你要过意不去，可以给我转一笔治疗费。”
毕竟为了救他，她自己的修复进度都放缓了。
叶峥同意了。
这一等，就等到了第三天中午。
叶峥能动后做的第一件事就是联系下属询问防线情况。
得知定远星守住了，他长出一口气，神色放松地从空间钮里拿出一瓶营养剂，大口干了。
唐斩月好奇地看了几眼，但还是很有分寸的没有询问，万一人家误会怎么办？
毕竟，食物在末世向来是最重要的物资，便是生死之交也不能轻易分享。
叶峥补充完体力后，起身活动了一下，而后走到唐斩月面前伸出手，“赤璃，回来了。”
唐斩月不舍地摸了摸小狗的脑袋，赤璃……名字还挺好听。
赤璃掀起眼皮看了眼叶峥，没动。
叶峥蹙眉，想让它回精神海，却意外地遭到了拒绝。
他无奈叹气，“暂时先麻烦你了。”
唐斩月笑起来，“不麻烦，我很喜欢它。”
叶峥耳尖有些泛红，一言不发的上了悬浮车。
——以前总听人说，精神体是人的潜意识，叶峥一直不以为然，但他现在有点信了。
叶峥坐在驾驶室内随手一点，一块光屏跳出来，他问：“地址是哪里？”

唐斩月在一旁默默学习，“不知道。”
叶峥一顿，缓缓看向她，“你家的地址，你不知道？”
“我失忆了呀。”唐斩月理所当然道，“我爸给悬浮车设定了自动驾驶，我不小心碰到了几个按钮，车开到这里就不动了。”
叶峥眸光微闪，怪不得能那么坦然地亲近赤璃，原来是不懂。
他一边找之前的定位记录，一边给出诚恳的建议，“恢复记忆前尽量不要出门，容易吃亏。”
唐斩月不解，“为什么这么说？”她这人吃什么都不会吃亏。
叶峥看着她抚摸赤璃的手，嘴角微微挑起，“当面说喜欢别人的精神体，等同于告白。不经过主人同意触碰别人的精神体，在星际法上被定义为性骚扰。”
唐斩月麻了。
这两天她都干了什么？！不仅拥抱抚摸了赤璃，她甚至还埋了肚子！！
唐斩月双手打开，再也不敢碰赤璃，“让它走。”
叶峥挑眉，瞥了赤璃一眼，“我可管不了它。”说着就启动悬浮车，往市区开去。
唐斩月低头跟赤璃大眼瞪小眼，“你回去吧，治疗结束了。”说着还狠心地收回了青莲。
赤璃耳朵耷拉下来，哼哼唧唧的看着她。
唐斩月狠下心，“不行，我不能当变态。”
一旁开车的叶峥闻言笑了声。
唐斩月心虚地看了他一眼，再次催促赤璃，“快回去。”
赤璃装傻，把脑袋往她怀里一埋就不动了。
content_en:
Tang Zhanyue touched the sleeping puppy in his arms, "Did you see the hover car over there? When you can move, drive me home."
Ye Zheng glanced at Chili in her arms with a strange expression.
After waiting for a few seconds, he said in surprise: "That's it?"
"That's it." Tang Zhanyue thought for a while and then said: "If you feel sorry for me, you can transfer me a treatment fee."
After all, in order to save him, her own repair progress had been slowed down.
Ye Zheng agreed.
This wait lasted until noon on the third day.
The first thing Ye Zheng did after he was able to move was to contact his subordinates to ask about the situation of the defense line.
When he learned that Dingyuan Star was defended, he let out a long breath, took out a bottle of nutrient supplement from the space button with a relaxed look, and took a big gulp.
Tang Zhanyue looked at it curiously, but still had the sense to not ask. What if someone misunderstood?
After all, food has always been the most important material in the last days, and it cannot be shared easily even between life and death.
After Ye Zheng replenished his strength, he stood up and moved around for a while, then walked to Tang Zhanyue and stretched out his hand, "Chili, you're back."
Tang Zhanyue reluctantly touched the puppy's head, Chili... the name was quite nice.
Chili raised her eyelids and glanced at Ye Zheng, but did not move.
Ye Zheng frowned and wanted it to return to the spiritual sea, but was unexpectedly rejected.
He sighed helplessly, "I'll bother you for now."
Tang Zhanyue laughed, "It's not troublesome, I like it very much."
The tips of Ye Zheng's ears were a little red, and he got on the hover car without saying a word.
——I have always heard people say that the spiritual body is the human subconscious. Ye Zheng has always disagreed, but now he somewhat believes it.
Ye Zheng was sitting in the cab, casually looking around, and a light screen popped out. He asked, "What's the address?"
Tang Zhanyue studied silently on the side, "I don't know."
Ye Zheng paused and looked at her slowly, "Don't you know your home address?"
"I lost my memory." Tang Zhanyue said matter-of-factly, "My dad set up automatic driving for the hover car. I accidentally touched a few buttons, and the car stopped moving when it got here."
Ye Zheng's eyes flashed slightly, no wonder he could get close to Chi Li so calmly, it turned out he didn't understand.
While looking for the previous positioning records, he gave sincere advice, "Try not to go out before recovering your memory. It is easy to suffer losses."
Tang Zhanyue was puzzled, "Why do you say that?" She would never suffer any loss.
Ye Zheng looked at her hand touching Chili and raised the corner of his mouth slightly, "To say you like someone else's spiritual body in person is equivalent to a confession. Touching someone else's spiritual body without the owner's consent is defined as sexual harassment in interstellar law."
Tang Zhanyue felt numb.
What has she done these two days? ! Not only did he hug and caress Chili, she even buried her belly! !
Tang Zhanyue opened his hands and never dared to touch Chili again, "Let him go."
Ye Zheng raised his eyebrows and glanced at Chi Li, "I can't control it." With that, he started the hover car and drove towards the city.
Tang Zhanyue lowered his head and glared at Chili, "Go back, the treatment is over." He said and cruelly took back Qinglian.
Chili's ears drooped and he looked at her with a groan.
Tang Zhanyue made a determined decision, "No, I can't be a pervert."
Ye Zheng, who was driving beside him, laughed when he heard this.
Tang Zhanyue gave him a guilty look and urged Chili again, "Go back quickly."
Chili pretended to be stupid, buried her head in her arms and stopped moving.
